page_title: UDI 1-3 NAP | Udinese v Napoli 14/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Daniele Doveri is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+1' Udinese will take a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Billy Gilmour (Napoli) in, Stanislav Lobotka out.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) comes onto the pitch for Matteo Politano.
85' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute David Neres and he is replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
83' Here is a change. Jordan Zemura is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Rui Modesto (Udinese).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lautaro Giannetti departs the field of play to be replaced by Iker Bravo (Udinese).
83' We are about to witness a substitution. James Abankwah (Udinese) is replacing Jurgen Ekkelenkamp.

81' 1 - 3 An amazing individual effort from Frank Anguissa (Napoli) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 1:3. Razvan Sava was helpless.
80' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Romelu Lukaku as he is replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
76' 1 - 2 Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) scores an unlucky own goal! He deflects a shot into his own net.
75' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Napoli.
74' David Neres (Napoli) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Napoli force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
73' Napoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
71' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
70' Substitution. Kingsley Ehizibue leaves the pitch and is replaced by Hassane Kamara (Udinese).
67' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
66' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Napoli comes to nothing.
66' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Napoli.
65' The current number of shots on goal is 3:3.
63' Great teamplay by Udinese as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
61' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

60' The cross into the penalty area from Matteo Politano (Napoli) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
59' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
57' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
56' Napoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
56' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Napoli have a corner.

55' Matteo Politano (Napoli) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot on goal, but the ball curls just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
53' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but Razvan Sava comes off his line to gather the ball.
50' 1 - 1 Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) finds himself one-on-one with the keeper after a great pass by Scott McTominay. He takes the shot early and scores!
47' The Napoli players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The whistle blows and Daniele Doveri starts the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Razvan Sava makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
42' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) commits a foul and Daniele Doveri immediately signals a free kick.
39' Arthur Atta (Udinese) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
38' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
38' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Now Udinese have a corner.

36' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Frank Anguissa (Napoli), who manages to steer it to the bottom right corner. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Razvan Sava makes a save in the nick of time to maintain the current score.
36' David Neres (Napoli) steps up to send the ball in.
36' David Neres (Napoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Napoli win a corner.
34' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Sandi Lovric leaves the pitch to be replaced by Arthur Atta (Udinese).
34' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
33' Napoli control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
31' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
30' The referee awards a corner and Matteo Politano (Napoli) goes over to take it.
30' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Napoli.
30' David Neres (Napoli) drives a shot towards the roof of the net from inside the box, but Razvan Sava leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
29' The Napoli players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
26' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:0.
22' 1 - 0 Goal! Florian Thauvin (Udinese) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 1:0.
22' Penalty saved! Florian Thauvin (Udinese) sends the penalty towards the left hand side of the goal, but Alex Meret pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
22' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is going to take the penalty!
22' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) probably handled the ball. Udinese are awarded a penalty!

19' David Neres (Napoli) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal! The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
18' Looks like Mathias Olivera (Napoli) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
17' 25:75 – the latest ball possession ratio.
15' The Udinese players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

13' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
12' Napoli are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
10' David Neres (Napoli) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
8' A quickly taken corner by Napoli.
7' David Neres (Napoli) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

6' David Neres (Napoli) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
5' Napoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
2' Neat passing move from Napoli in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Daniele Doveri is the one to supervise the game today.
